slices.title: Baseline and aggregate-law ledger
slices.summary: Baseline ledger committed with 261 semantic-state tests, 6376 repository tests, unchanged inference metrics, exact API-absence characterization, and regenerated reachability evidence.

slices.title: Aggregate identity and stable scoped names
slices.summary: Extended the existing deterministic identity scope with nominal composition, group, member, and settled-boundary identities; reconstruction, sibling insertion, invalid names, and foreign scopes are covered.

slices.title: Composition declaration grammar
slices.summary: Added the closed serializable declaration grammar: explicit sequence order, one-body named groups, leaf-only demonstrated-independent cohorts with evidence, and typed prepared-family members; empty, recursive, ambiguous, and closure-shaped inputs fail.

slices.title: Structural composition validation
slices.summary: Whole-tree validation now rejects duplicate scopes, foreign schemas, unknown or drifting definitions, reused application identities, reconstructed cycles, and missing source metadata before a compiled plan or family apply exists.

slices.title: Declared transition footprints
slices.summary: Existing transition plans now project immutable exact target footprints with distinct semantic-write, discrete-write, and presentation-only sets; exact repeats normalize and competing, derived, or foreign writes fail.

slices.title: Conflict and hazard diagnostics
slices.summary: A pure data-only preflight now rejects foreign bases, duplicate graph or application authority, graph incompatibility, unresolved footprints, and semantic or discrete collisions inside independent cohorts before any family apply or endpoint exists.

slices.title: Deterministic composition compilation
slices.summary: Validated preflight data now compiles into frozen nested nodes, stable scoped member and group identities, canonical independent-cohort order, authored sequence order, and one deterministic settled boundary specification per executable step.

slices.title: Persistent ordered endpoint chain
slices.summary: Ordered members now execute only through validated prepared applications on existing family and transaction authority; the immutable result retains every exact member commit and settled snapshot, preserves sharing, correspondence, recovery, and identity, and exposes no partial chain on failure.

slices.title: Independent-cohort confluence and endpoint order
slices.summary: Independent cohorts now retain compiler-canonical ordinary endpoints only after privately executing the reverse legal order and proving every concrete, absent, and derived slot value-equivalent; hidden cross-member reads and graph drift fail before a chain escapes.

slices.title: Explicit overlapping-write sequence
slices.summary: Repeated writes are proven legal only through explicit authored sequence order: both ordinary transactions execute, the middle and final snapshots recover directly, reversed order changes inspectable meaning, and the same pair fails independent preflight.

slices.title: Nested group ownership and aggregate provenance
slices.summary: Nested group and member ownership now forms one frozen read-only evidence index over exact compiled source references, endpoint applications, commits, and existing change, provenance, correspondence, and lineage authorities; reparameterized branch provenance remains intact and incomplete projection ownership fails closed.

slices.title: Generated boundary and member handles
slices.summary: Compiled plans now preserve declaration literal types through validation and preflight and generate frozen serializable composition, before/after boundary, complete settled-boundary, nested group, and member handles; static paths and parameter inference require no author-supplied semantic IDs or casts.

slices.title: Disjoint logical address protocol
slices.summary: Logical addresses are now a closed serializable union: settled values retain one canonical boundary handle and no progress, while in-transition values retain one member or demonstrated-independent cohort handle plus canonical exact progress; equality and JSON encoding round-trip and all foreign, mixed, malformed, or noncanonical forms fail closed.

slices.title: Settled direct seek and pinned inspection
slices.summary: Settled handles and addresses now resolve directly to exact retained persistent snapshots and typed pinned state trees through an immutable ordinal index, with no replay, evaluator calls, cache mutation, or mutable cursor.

slices.title: Single-member transition seek
slices.summary: Ordered member addresses now resolve at exact progress through the existing family evaluator from each member own adjacent retained boundaries; endpoints preserve persistent identity, interiors remain ephemeral, nonmonotonic seeks are deterministic, prior state remains settled, and later writes stay absent.

slices.title: Independent-cohort aggregate overlays
slices.summary: Independent cohort addresses now resolve all member drivers at one exact progress over one shared retained before boundary, preserve member-specific transient tokens, return exact persistent endpoints, reject collisions, and expose no aggregate snapshot, version, copied store, or derived-value interpolation.

slices.title: Aggregate requested derived evaluation
slices.summary: Aggregate cohort interiors now evaluate one requested typed derived closure through the current existing graph and request-local memo, freeze the completed handle view, retain unaffected persistent dependency authority, share diamond work once, and publish no partial result or cross-request cache.

slices.title: Mode authority and compiler checkpoint
slices.summary: Aggregate cohort resolutions now preserve exact transition declarations as frozen member authority; interpolation and discrete modes alone produce semantic drivers, presentation-only metadata cannot substitute semantic state, every direct seek leaves retained boundaries and application history reference-exact, and the one approved compiler ratchet is directly attributed and formula-bounded.
